itens.titulo: Amazon: AWS, AI Chips, & Retail Expansion Spur Growth
itens.descricao: Amazon: AWS, AI Chips, & Retail Expansion Spur Growth Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Amazon Company Overview Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) Amazon (AMZN) is the leading e-commerce company, with operating sprawling across North America and the globe.
The company's online retail business revolves around the Prime program and a vast and efficient distribution network which delivered its fastest delivery speeds in 2025.
Amazon has also diversified into the custom AI chip business, and its Trainium and Graviton chips now produce a combined annual revenue run rate of more then $10 billion.
For example, in Q3, AWS sales increased 39% year-over-year while retail grew 6% and advertising grew 10.9%.
Meanwhile, Amazon gross margins jumped to 51.4%, its highest level ever.
Image Source: Zacks Investment Research Amazon Benefits from the AI Boom According to the latest guidance, big tech capital expenditures are expected to soar to $1.4 trillion in 2027 (+60% YoY).
Meanwhile, management noted that commitments for custom chips exploded 20-fold year-over-year.
Revenues have grown each year over the past 5 years and are expected to be close to $1 trillion next year.

itens.titulo: Amazon Stocks Jump 4.3% With Upgrade Putting AWS Cash Conversion in Focus
itens.descricao: Amazon Stocks Jump 4.3% With Upgrade Putting AWS Cash Conversion in Focus Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), the e-commerce and cloud giant, has a fresh Buy ratingand a $42.4 billion cash-flow hurdle.
Shares rose 4.3% to $250.64 at 9:48 a.m.
ET during November 2 regular trading.
Phillip Securities upgraded the company from Accumulate and raised its price target to $330 from $320, The Fly reported.
GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with AMZN.
Amazon's October 29 results showed AWS generating $46 billion in revenue and $17.8 billion in operating income.
That translates into a 38.7% operating margin, with the cloud division delivering roughly 63% of group operating income on about 23% of sales.
Total revenue reached $201.9 billion, while operating income came to $28.1 billion.
